decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The approved means of access shall be permanently removed before completion of the approved housing development unless approval in writing is obtained from the Local Planning Authority and the land reinstated in accordance with the landscaping details approved in accordance with condition 6 of planning permission reference: 00051/LA/P3.
Condition : 3 - Vehicles using the approved means of access shall only turn right into the site from Bedfont Road and left out of the site onto Bedfont Road.
Condition : 4 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on 16 October 2005 when the use shall cease
description: Installation of temporary access for construction traffic onto Bedfont Road
